about: The failure this protocol exists to survive: `job.finish` is written to a socket
that dies before the receipt comes back.
The agent reconnects with `hello.resume`, is told the session survived, and re-sends
the terminal frame it never got a receipt for. That frame is the SAME file, which is
the whole point -- a re-send is byte-identical, envelope id included, so the receiver
recognises it by id and answers `receipt.duplicate: true` instead of finishing the
